comment: Modelling both an abstract actor and a concrete system as Application Components creates ambiguity. Automated checks may not reliably distinguish a reference role from a deployed product.

anchor.note: p.80 l.Lines 1013-1020 read as the printed page; section 3.7.2 agrees

public.text: Modelling both an abstract actor and a concrete system as Application Components creates ambiguity. Automated checks may not reliably distinguish a reference role from a deployed product.
public.suggestedRevision: Introduce a mandatory type or stereotype property distinguishing abstract actor roles, reference components, national logical components, concrete systems, and test simulators. Apply a consistent naming and identifier convention.
